name: Ramanujan
description: The partition function p(n), its generating function painted over the unit disk, and the Hardy–Ramanujan formula.
aria: Domain colouring of the partition generating function over the unit disk
intro: How many ways can you split 200 into whole numbers? Almost four trillion. Ramanujan found the formula by listening to a function that explodes at every root of unity. This is that function.
